gloss_en: Teshuvah Ila'ah — the kabbalistic 'higher/supernal repentance' (Aramaic ila'ah, 'upper'), the elevated level of return associated with Binah in Lurianic Kabbalah, here identified with the constriction of the throat (meitzar ha-garon) symbolized by Egypt; distinct from ordinary/lower repentance (teshuvah tata'ah)
